headline: StubHub, the ticket marketplace, has made its live event listings and prices available inside Anthropic's Claude AI assistant.
score_reason: Pool score 4 lowered by 2: the announcement dates from 23 Apr 2026, over five months old, and the main claims are StubHub's own.
importance_line: Ticket buyers can ask Claude about events and see live prices without leaving the chat, but purchases still happen on StubHub, the launch is months old, and the claim of being the only major ticketing platform on several assistants is StubHub's own.
summary: TicketNews reports that StubHub said fans can search its live listings, prices and seat availability inside Claude and are then sent to StubHub to complete any purchase. This is older news: StubHub announced it on 23 Apr 2026, and the claim that it is the only major ticketing platform available across several leading AI assistants is the company's own.
notes: Older news re-dated by the feed (TicketNews URL is /2026/04/); announcement date 23 Apr 2026 taken from Google News listings of the Business Wire release.
